about: The main quest (rules/quests.gd reads it). Chapters in order: one Light Stone per land, then the Shadowgate. Like quests.json, plus 'relic' (the stone id you are given when the chapter ends) and 'next'. Goals: cave:LAND, defeat:LAND:KIND:N (KIND any = any foe), lookout:LAND, stones:N, found:ID, has:ITEM:N, portal, castle, king. LAND is a land id (rules/names.gd). 'story' holds the story cards: [title, words, picture]. {hero} is the player's name, {relic} the stone, {count} how many are held.

opening: Seven lands once lay under one sun, and the Umbral Reach lay beneath them all, a realm that has never known a dawn. Between them stood the Shadowgate, sealed by seven Light Stones.

A prince of the Reach crossed the Gate and saw the sun. He asked for a share of it and was driven back with spears. A hundred winters of darkness turned his grief to iron. Now he wears a crown of shadow and calls himself King.
The seals are cracking. Each night the King reaches through and drinks a little more of the light. The old folk have a name for it: the Shadowfall. When it is done, no fire will burn again.
The seven Light Stones were hidden long ago, one in every land, and the keepers who knew the way are few and old. The things that crawl out of the gloom hunt for them too.
You wake in Emberhold, the last village that still keeps its fires lit. Warden Maera is waiting at the lantern. Take up your blade, {hero}. (Q shows your quests.)
relic: {hero} raises {relic}, and for a heartbeat the whole land remembers the sun. The gloom draws back. {count} of 7.

steps.text: Go down into the Mine beneath Emberhold and walk out again
Return to Warden Maera at the lantern
Go north to Thornwick in the Weepingwold and find Old Mother Wenna
Cut down 4 of the things that haunt the Weepingwold
Climb the old watchtower in the Weepingwold
Return to Old Mother Wenna
Find Corran the Ferryman on the shore of the Drowned Mere
Brave the Mine beneath the Drowned Mere
Return to Corran
Seek Ser Aldric, last of the Hollow Guard, in Hollowcrown
Lay 3 of the risen bonewalkers of Hollowcrown back to rest
Return to Ser Aldric
Cross into the Wintermarch and find Hrefna the Huntress
Bring down 3 frost wolves
Climb a watchtower in the Wintermarch
Return to Hrefna
Hold 5 Light Stones, and the Ashen Gate will know you
Pass the Ashen Gate and find Sefa at the last well
Survive the Mine beneath the Cinder Wastes
Return to Sefa
Cross the black water to Morwen's hut in the Mirefen
Drive off 3 bog lurkers
Return to Morwen
Bear all seven Stones to the Shadowgate and step through
Kindle the three dead shrines of the Umbral Reach, forge Sunfang and breach the castle
End the Shadow King
